name: Question 15
problem: A pumping station adds sand to Sandy Beach at a rate of $3\sqrt{t}$ cubic yards per hour. The tide removes the sand from the beach at a rate of $2t$ cubic yards per hour. If at time $t=0$ the beach contains $1\,500$ cubic yards of sand, write an expression for $A(t),$ the total number of cubic yards of sand on the beach at any time $t>0.$
worked_solution:
Let $a(t)=3\sqrt{t}-2t$ be the rate at which the volume of sand at Sandy Beach is changing. Note that we subtract $2t$ to indicate the rate at which the volume is decreasing.

Let $A(T)$ be the volume of sand on the beach at any time after $T$ minutes. Using our formula for the accumulation of change, we have

$$
A(T)=A(0)+{\int }_{0}^{T}a(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

Substituting the known information and carrying out the necessary integration gives

$$
\begin{aligned}A(T) & =A(0)+{\int }_{0}^{T}a(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =1\,500+{\int }_{0}^{T}(3\sqrt{t}-2t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =1\,500+{(2{t}^{3/2}-{t}^{2})|}_{0}^{T} \\  & =1\,500+2{T}^{3/2}-{T}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, let's rewrite our final answer in terms of the original variable $t.$ We have 

$$
A(t)=2{t}^{3/2}-{t}^{2}+1\,500.
$$

Question 15
?

A pumping station adds sand to Sandy Beach at a rate of 3t cubic yards per hour. The tide removes the sand from the beach at a rate of 2t cubic yards per hour. If at time t=0 the beach contains 1500 cubic yards of sand, write an expression for A(t), the total number of cubic yards of sand on the beach at any time t>0.

a
A(t)=2t3/2−t2+1500
b
A(t)=3t3/2−t2+1500
c
A(t)=t3/2−t2+1500
d
A(t)=2t3/2+t2+1500
e
A(t)=2t3/23+t2+1500
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Let a(t)=3t−2t be the rate at which the volume of sand at Sandy Beach is changing. Note that we subtract 2t to indicate the rate at which the volume is decreasing.

Let A(T) be the volume of sand on the beach at any time after T minutes. Using our formula for the accumulation of change, we have A(T)=A(0)+∫0Ta(t)dt.

Substituting the known information and carrying out the necessary integration gives A(T)=A(0)+∫0Ta(t)dt=1500+∫0T(3t−2t)dt=1500+(2t3/2−t2)|0T=1500+2T3/2−T2.

Finally, let's rewrite our final answer in terms of the original variable t. We have A(t)=2t3/2−t2+1500.
